## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-doc`, `mod-frost`, `area:global_attention`.

## Affected area

Documentation or samples

## Summary

Adds a GH200 entry to the SM90 section of `python/cudnn/sdpa/frost/SUPPORT_MATRIX_TRACKER.md`, next to the H200 validation of 2026-09-20: the three in-tree SM90 forward files at L0/L1 on GH200 with the FROST engines opted in.

## Why

The SM90 row had one recorded run (H200). This adds a second Hopper part with a different host (Grace, aarch64), so a regression that shows on one and not the other has a reference point. Mentioned in #378.

## Related issues

Related to #378.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Documentation only.

## Testing

GH200 (sm_90), develop `4cd4e613` plus this branch (rebased onto `fa065f1e` after the runs; the commits in between add SM100/SM107 entries elsewhere in the tracker), CuTe DSL 4.8.1, cuDNN 9.27.0, torch 2.14.1+cu130, CUDA 13.2, `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`, run from `test/python`:

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `python -m pytest -m "L0 or L1" sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_dsl_sm90.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_native_sm90_binding.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_prepared_sm90.py` | 271 passed |
